lesson.title: Crowded air, roomier band
lesson.goal: The cafe and the barber share a wall, and their 2.4 GHz radios interfere. IEEE 802.11 gives the 2.4 GHz band only three non-overlapping channels, so move BarberAP to the 5 GHz band where many more channels fit without overlapping.

step.text: Open CafeAP, Wireless tab. The Radio row shows channel 1 and warns that BarberAP on channel 3 overlaps.
In 2.4 GHz, IEEE 802.11 fits only channels 1, 6 and 11 without overlap. Two neighbours cannot both spread out here.
The 5 GHz band is much wider: channels 36 to 165 all sit apart, so any two 5 GHz radios leave each other alone.
Open BarberAP and move its radio to the 5 GHz band, channel 36. Then check CafeAP again.
